captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a large passenger blimp with a streamlined, cream-colored main envelope. An elongated dark grey cabin is suspended underneath, featuring multiple small windows. At the rear, a cruciform tail assembly consists of four large cream fins with thin, dark grey movable rudder/elevator control surfaces at their trailing edges. Two small propeller pods are mounted on short horizontal struts on either side of the cabin, each with a dark propeller. The propellers spin continuously on their local axes, while the vertical and horizontal tail control surfaces are hinged to swing left-to-right and up-and-down.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a passenger blimp. It should feature a large, streamlined main envelope in cream, an underslung dark grey cabin with window cutouts, a cruciform tail assembly with four fins and movable trailing-edge control surfaces, and two lateral propeller pods with rotating propeller blades.
captions.factory: The code constructs the main envelope using a loft or a revolved spline to form the streamlined body. The underslung cabin is created using a box or extruded profile with window cutouts subtracted via boolean operations. The four tail fins are modeled using thin boxes or extruded shapes, and the movable control surfaces are attached via revolute joints at the trailing edges. The lateral engine pods are created using small cylinders connected by horizontal struts, with multi-blade propellers attached via continuous joints to simulate rotation.
